## What's free

Free forever plan: uptime monitoring for up to 50 resources with email alerts; 30-day full trial without a card

> Free tiers change without notice. Check <https://www.site24x7.com/site24x7-pricing.html> before relying on this.

## Notes

Paid plans fall back to the free plan when they lapse. Older pages quote 5 monitors; the pricing page says 50.

## Plan

- `modules/<service>`: the managed resources, sized to the free tier by default
- `stack/`: the root module whose outputs expose connection details (sensitive values marked `sensitive`)
